messages:
nicole_cs: Quick check for Crestview cutover in 18h. Two issues: (1) their VPC endpoint for CloudWatch logs isn't accepting our PutLogEvents (403), and (2) our forwarder reports KMS Decrypt failures reading archived envelopes. Need fast triage + minimal go-live plan. :alarm_clock:

ash_neteng: For the VPC endpoint, confirm whether it's an interface endpoint and what SGs are attached. 403 often from SG egress or NACL. Ask them to run `aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=service-name,Values=com.amazonaws.*logs*` and paste ENI SGs.

rav_kms: Decrypt fail: is the CMK multi-account? If so, the key policy must include the assumed-role principal and the `kms:Decrypt` action. If org SCPs are present a grant won't help. Ask for the CloudTrail Deny event and the exact KMS AccessDenied message.

laura_sec: Security note: avoid broad key policy edits. For quick cutover we can request a scoped grant or ask them to create a short-lived delivery prefix so we can rotate to a new CMK that already allows decrypt. Also log this as a renewal risk if they require operator grants repeatedly.

triage-bot: Reminder  Crestview onboarding ticket #CV-820 needs go/no-go update in 18h. Please record blockers.

nicole_cs: Plan: (A) Ash posts the endpoint diagnostic to CV-820; (B) Rav drafts a `aws kms create-grant` snippet with EncryptionContextSubset we can ask them to run if they confirm role ARN; (C) Laura drafts the minimal security guardrails for any temporary grant and renewal note. If no response in 90m we open a 15m bridge. Acks?

ash_neteng: Ack. Posting endpoint cmd and quick SG check to ticket now.

rav_kms: Ack. Draft grant: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::556677889900:role/crestview-logs --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"project":"crestview"}`. Will include revoke command.

laura_sec: Ack. Adding renewal-risk line: "Operational friction: repeated short-lived grants or manual bucket/policy changes for audit delivery increase support burden; consider managed logging add-on at renewal."

nicole_cs: Thanks team. I'll update CV-820 and ping customer for the diagnostic outputs. If they can't confirm role + SGs in 1.5h we schedule bridge. :white_check_mark:
